[Council File 26-1218; CD 2]
Motion (Nazarian - McOsker) relative to authorizing the Department of Building and Safety to waive the outstanding balance of the lien in the amount of $1,103.48 for the property located at 5845 Cleon Avenue, which is inclusive of all associated fees and accumulated interest.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Waive outstanding lien balance of $1,103.48 for property at 5845 Cleon Avenue.

outcome.text: Planning and Land Use Management Committee approved item(s) (Sep 8, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Sep 18, 2026); Council action final
